conclusion: M122 repairs Barnes-Hut wording: the current prepared aggregate-frontier device-column route is useful device-resident work inside the OptiX backend, implemented with CUDA driver kernels, but it is not current RT-core traversal evidence. Barnes-Hut RT-core wording now requires the future fused aggregate-tree primitive plus an OptiX launch/trace proof.
fused_contract_rt_core_requirements: OptiX implementation must launch an OptiX pipeline, not only CUDA kernels
device program must call optixTrace or equivalent hardware traversal
timing packet must separate BVH build, optixLaunch traversal, continuation, and copies
